description: Turns an online video into text a model can fully understand
notes: inspectvideo also runs llama-server, which Scoop does not install:
download a Windows build from https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases and put llama-server.exe on PATH.
inspectvideo downloads no model weights: fetch each once (~11GB) with hf download,
It names everything missing, each model with its exact hf download <repo> <file> line.
